title: HOW GOOGLE ADS
*GETS YOU*
CALLS
slides.sub: Five steps from a Sydney search to your phone ringing.

title: 7AM.
*BURST PIPE.*
PARRAMATTA.
slides.body: Someone types "emergency plumber Parramatta" into Google, and five settings in your Google Ads decide whose phone rings.

title: PAY FOR
*READY-TO-BOOK*
SEARCHES
slides.body: Pay for searches like "blocked drain Chatswood". Skip "how to unblock a drain". That person is already holding a plunger.

title: SHOW YOUR AD
*WHERE YOU WORK*
slides.body: By default, Google also shows your ad to people who live elsewhere but searched about your area. Switch the location setting to "Presence".

title: PUT THE SEARCH
*IN YOUR*
HEADLINE
slides.body: Someone searched "blocked drain Chatswood". Your headline says "Blocked Drains Fixed in Chatswood". Plain words win the click.

title: SEND CLICKS
*TO A PAGE*
THAT SELLS
slides.body: One service, one suburb, phone number at the top. A homepage still showing 2019 Christmas hours loses the job. (We've all seen one.)

title: COUNT
*EVERY CALL*
slides.body: Add a call button and count every call as a conversion. Without call tracking, Google chases clicks. Clicks don't pay your rent.

title: *RECAP*
items: Put the search in your headline
Land clicks on a page with your number

title: WANT A
